result.brief: 提出语言条件世界模型任务 LCWM 与跨域基准 LCWM-Bench，并给出结合扩散策略提议、轨迹排序与视频世界模型想象验证的规划智能体 Tiresias。
result.reason: Language-conditioned world model with video-pretrained imagination and visual rollout ranking; benchmark spans navigation, robotics, driving. Main contribution is planning agent plus benchmark, so secondary application tier.
